dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, what's the most famous place in Bangkok?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌts ðə ˈmoʊst ˈfeɪməs ˈpleɪs ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Wat Arun, I think. It's the most attractive temple in the city.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɑːt əˈruːn, aɪ ˈθɪŋk. ɪts ðə ˈmoʊst əˈtræktɪv ˈtɛmpəl ɪn ðə ˈsɪti.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: When is the best time to go there?
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛn ɪz ðə ˈbɛst ˈtaɪm tə ˈɡoʊ ˈðɛr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In the evening. It's beautiful at sunset.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ði ˈiːvnɪŋ. ɪts ˈbjuːtəfəl ət ˈsʌnsɛt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The afternoon. It's the hottest and the most crowded time.
dialogue.reading: ði ˌæftərˈnuːn. ɪts ðə ˈhɑːtɪst ənd ðə ˈmoʊst ˈkraʊdɪd ˈtaɪm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What's the least expensive way to get there?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌts ðə ˈliːst ɪkˈspɛnsɪv ˈweɪ tə ˈɡɛt ˈðɛr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: By boat. And after that, let's eat Thai food. It's the best food in the world!
dialogue.reading: baɪ ˈboʊt. ənd ˈæftər ˈðæt, ˈlɛts ˈiːt ˈtaɪ ˈfuːd. ɪts ðə ˈbɛst ˈfuːd ɪn ðə ˈwɜːrld!
